connector.name: GlobKurier Shipping MCP
connector.registryDescription: Track shipments and search shipping products (DPD, InPost, DHL, FedEx, UPS, GLS) via GlobKurier API.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.globkurier.pl over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package globkurier-api-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the globkurier-pl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
